tasks.short: Budget production resources and approve expenditures

steps.what: Translate production targets into resource and efficiency constraints
outputs: resource-budget assumptions and limits

steps.what: Gather actual usage, current prices, staffing costs and requested expenditure quantities
inputs: existing approved price and staffing cost records
outputs: reconciled budget input rows and missing items

steps.what: Assemble the resource budget and expenditure comparisons by production target
inputs: reconciled budget input rows and missing items
outputs: resource budget and expenditure comparison draft v1

steps.what: Judge efficient resource use and decide which budgets or expenditures are acceptable
inputs: resource budget and expenditure comparison draft v1
outputs: resource allocation and expenditure decisions

steps.what: Finalize and approve the budget, expenditure decisions and intended recipients
inputs: resource budget and expenditure comparison draft v1
outputs: approved resource budget and decisions v1 with recipients

steps.what: Save the approved budget and expenditure decisions in the current record
inputs: approved resource budget and decisions v1 with recipients
outputs: saved resource budget and decisions v1

steps.what: Send the approved budget and expenditure decisions to the named resource owners
inputs: saved resource budget and decisions v1
approved resource budget and decisions v1 with recipients
outputs: approved decisions sent to resource owners

tasks.design: Configure {ERP} and {HCM} budget input views and a deterministic {SPREADSHEET} resource-budget draft. The manager chooses assumptions and expenditures, approves the completed decisions and recipients, then a separate gated {EMAIL} send delivers them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource usage, costs and requests can require reconciliation across records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native budget views and field mapping can reduce manual gathering and budget assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Decide whether resource use will meet production targets efficiently.
tasks.human_edge: Balance capacity, quality, cost and operational uncertainty.

ambition.what: Review resource scenarios more often with traceable inputs.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; cost access and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured usage, price and staffing records can feed deterministic budget comparisons.

assumptions: Boundary is budget development and expenditure approval, including communicating decisions; purchasing, paying and hiring are separate actions.

Existing operations records supply actual quantities and hours by order/resource/period; purchasing maintains price, currency, validity and unit; staffing records supply authorized role cost and availability; request owners already supply item, quantity, purpose and due date. s2 resolves missing inputs manually. s1 captures target quantities, capacity limits and planning assumptions; no planned quantity becomes an actual.

Use native budgeting first. Central requires actual current input reconciliation and manual budget assembly; it does not count spreadsheet arithmetic runtime. The hypotheses remove 40% of gathering and 70% of assembly effort, not judgement.
Same-system save takes approximately zero time and minimum 1 is retained. Final versions exist at s5 before both gates; edits void approvals. Only a real send earns send savings.
Provisional B=100, R=72, gross=28; focal upkeep=1; net=27. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current gathering, assembly and sending effort
research_questions: Trace one resource budget from production targets to final expenditure decisions and time manual work.

already_counted.description: Resolve incomplete resource and cost inputs
Check the final budget, decisions and recipients

incremental.description: Maintain cost-field mappings and inspect delivery failures

approvals.approved_version: approved resource budget and decisions v1 with recipients
approved resource budget and decisions v1 with recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native budgeting already covers the proposed work. High: central 28 gross points face seven extra input-exception hours plus one upkeep hour, leaving 20.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify current quality-control learning needs for materials, technology and statistical methods
outputs: quality-control reading topics and search terms

steps.what: Search and screen current literature alerts for the selected quality-control topics
inputs: quality-control reading topics and search terms
outputs: candidate articles with date and source references

steps.what: Read and critically assess the articles, methods and statistical claims
inputs: candidate articles with date and source references
outputs: understood findings and limitations

steps.what: Compare the findings with the facility's materials and quality-control practice
outputs: applicability assessment and remaining learning needs

steps.what: Record useful findings, source references and follow-up reading needs
inputs: applicability assessment and remaining learning needs
candidate articles with date and source references
outputs: updated quality-control learning notes

tasks.design: Configure saved topic searches and dated alerts in {OTHER}, the publication catalogue, using the manager's quality-control questions. The manager reads the sources, checks statistical claims and records applicability in {DOCS}; no generated summary substitutes for reading.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant material is mixed with unrelated publication alerts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic, date and keyword filters can reduce routine search screening.
tasks.still_hard: Judge study quality and transferability to the facility.
tasks.human_edge: Understand limitations and connect evidence to local production.

ambition.what: Review a current, focused set of quality-control literature.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved publication searches can filter by topic and date, while critical reading remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary is keeping knowledge current, including learning notes, not implementing a new quality programme.

Publication catalogues supply title, abstract, date, authors and source identifier. s1 captures the manager's topics and terms. Missing metadata and inaccessible articles require manual search in s2; no new data producer is assumed.

Native saved searches come first. Central hypothesizes half of routine search/screening effort removed; full critical reading and applicability judgement remain. Existing focused alerts eliminate the incremental saving.
Provisional B=100, R=90, gross=10; focal incremental=1; net=9. Shares are task-based, not means priors.
research_questions: Compare saved-search results with the manager's own reading selections and inspect missed relevant studies.

already_counted.description: Screen candidate sources and handle missing search results

incremental.description: Tune search terms and audit missed topic coverage

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: current saved searches already suffice. High: ten hours of screening reduction require three extra hours of missed-source checks and one upkeep hour, leaving six.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate maintenance procedures and machine replacement recommendations

steps.what: Inspect equipment needs and confer with maintenance specialists on observed failures
outputs: observed maintenance and replacement needs

steps.what: Compare maintenance history, downtime and existing replacement information
inputs: existing actual maintenance and downtime records
outputs: checked history and option comparison

steps.what: Choose recommended maintenance procedures or modification options and record their rationale
outputs: selected recommendation components and rationale notes

steps.what: Compose the maintenance or replacement recommendation document
inputs: selected recommendation components and rationale notes
outputs: maintenance recommendation draft v1

loop.purpose: Explain the manager's chosen recommendation without inventing technical procedures
loop.input: Chosen options, actual history references and recorded rationale
loop.check: Manager checks causal claims, option trade-offs, stated limits and fidelity to specialist constraints
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual completion
loop.why_not_simpler: Option rationale is free text and needs a coherent explanation; numeric history tables remain deterministic

steps.what: Revise and approve the final recommendation and its maintenance-team recipients
inputs: selected recommendation components and rationale notes
outputs: approved maintenance recommendation v1 with recipients

steps.what: Save the approved recommendation in its current document record
inputs: approved maintenance recommendation v1 with recipients
outputs: saved maintenance recommendation v1

steps.what: Send the approved recommendation to the maintenance and facility team
inputs: approved maintenance recommendation v1 with recipients
outputs: maintenance recommendation sent

tasks.design: Use {OPS_SYSTEM} history and {ERP} option records to prepare a comparison, then draft the manager's selected recommendation in {DOCS}. The manager checks the final rationale and recipients before a separately gated {EMAIL} send; no machine modifies equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Maintenance evidence and recommendation prose require manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records can support deterministic comparisons and bounded narrative drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Select a maintenance or replacement approach that fits actual equipment conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Coordinate specialist advice and accept operational trade-offs.

ambition.what: Revisit maintenance options with traceable history.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance-history comparisons and source-bound recommendation drafts can support human maintenance decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is recommendation and coordination, not performing maintenance or buying replacement equipment.

Maintenance staff already record asset ID, actual fault/action, date, downtime and outcome; procurement's existing quotations contain option ID, specification, price and validity. s2 handles missing data manually. In s3 the manager captures chosen option, constraints, rationale, responsibilities and intended timing from actual discussion; no model invents a safe procedure.

Check native history reports and recommendation templates first. Central removes 40% of comparison assembly and half of recommendation composition; inspections, choices and final review stay unchanged.
Same-document save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is fully retained. Final revisions precede approval and any edit voids both gates. Send savings require a real current send.
Provisional B=100, R=77.5, gross=22.5; focal incremental=1.5; net=21, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Trace recommendations to actual maintenance records and time all draft corrections.

already_counted.description: Verify recommendation meaning and final recipients

incremental.description: Audit recommendation fidelity, source mappings and send failures

approvals.approved_version: approved maintenance recommendation v1 with recipients
approved maintenance recommendation v1 with recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native reports and templates already cover the manual work. High: 22.5 gross points require six extra missing-record/correction hours and 1.5 upkeep hours, leaving 15.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify the inventory or cost-control problem and define programme objectives
outputs: programme objectives and scope

steps.what: Assemble actual stock movements, losses and cost variances for the programme baseline
outputs: reconciled inventory and cost baseline with exceptions

steps.what: Choose inventory or cost controls and their operating limits
inputs: reconciled inventory and cost baseline with exceptions
outputs: selected controls and proposed operating limits

steps.what: Coordinate control responsibilities, pilot timing and exception handling with production and stores
inputs: selected controls and proposed operating limits
outputs: agreed programme responsibilities and pilot arrangements

steps.what: Write and approve the inventory or cost-control programme and review measures
inputs: agreed programme responsibilities and pilot arrangements
selected controls and proposed operating limits
reconciled inventory and cost baseline with exceptions
outputs: approved control programme v1

steps.what: Save the approved programme in the current project record
outputs: saved control programme v1

tasks.design: Configure {ERP} and {BI} to assemble actual inventory and cost variances for the programme baseline. The manager chooses controls, coordinates the pilot and records the agreed programme in {PROJECT}; the view does not itself change stock policies.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme preparation can require manual assembly of transaction and cost records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native variance reports can populate a consistent baseline from existing actuals.
tasks.still_hard: Choose controls that reduce waste without disrupting production.
tasks.human_edge: Set operating limits and coordinate adoption.

ambition.what: Review control programmes against a consistent actual baseline.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; transaction visibility and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory transactions and cost records can support deterministic variance reports, with human reconciliation.

assumptions: Boundary includes initiating and coordinating the programme, its baseline and written plan. Routine stock counts, purchasing and policy implementation are separate work, not removed here.

Existing stores transactions provide item/lot/location, actual receipt/issue/adjustment quantity, time and reason; existing finance/production records provide period, cost centre, actual cost and applicable comparison budget. Owners already capture these for normal operations. s2 resolves missing reasons and period mismatches manually; no new scanning or feed is assumed.
Configure native reports first. Central hypothesizes 60% less human assembly in s2 only, excluding report runtime and retaining all programme judgement, coordination and writing.
Same-project save is effectively zero; its minimum 1 share earns no saving. Final programme exists before approval; edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=88, gross=12; focal upkeep=1; net=11, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Transaction completeness and native reporting coverage
research_questions: Reconcile one programme baseline to actual stock and cost entries and measure exception work.

already_counted.description: Reconcile transaction and cost baseline exceptions

incremental.description: Check baseline definitions and report mappings after system changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native reporting already supplies the baseline. High: 12 hours of assembly reduction need three additional exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving eight.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Production managers retain resource, maintenance and control decisions while native records reduce supported preparation work.
reach: Maintenance specialists: establish actual equipment needs
Stores and finance: reconcile actual inventory and cost records
skills_to_grow: Review recommendation meaning and exact send versions
role.ambitious_version: A production manager who can revisit resource and control choices using traceable actual records, while retaining operational judgement.
